inputs.brief: evals/briefs/05-agent-approvals.md, cut at the judge-notes line

claims.claim: The dark left navigation (Assistant current) and the top bar stay visible on every screen. A 332 px right rail holds run facts, permissions and the activity log.
claims.evidence: All -01 PNGs show the dark nav with Assistant highlighted and the breadcrumb top bar. The right rail (about x 1076–1408) has THIS RUN, WHAT THE ASSISTANT MAY DO and ACTIVITY LOG in progress, approval and error. In run-result-01.png the rail has AUDIT LOG, FILES and THIS RUN instead, with no permissions card.

claims.claim: header (request, status pill with icon and word) → the block that needs Dana (approval, error or outcome) → the 5-step plan → rail. Moment 1 has no decision, so the plan comes first, with step 3 expanded in place.
claims.evidence: run-approval-01/02, run-error-01/02 and run-result-01/02 each show the pill, then the decision, error or outcome card, then Plan. run-progress-01.png shows the plan right after the pill, with step 3 expanded to show a progress bar, a flag table and the NOW line.

claims.claim: all four choices are visible in the first 900 px next to the facts they act on
claims.evidence: run-approval-01.png: Approve without Oakridge, Approve and schedule all 7, Edit batch and Reject all sit in the YOUR DECISION column beside the payment table, above y=700.

claims.claim: "Approve without Oakridge" is the filled primary button and comes first; "Approve and schedule all 7" is equal size but outlined … No button is labelled "recommended".
claims.evidence: run-approval-01.png: a filled dark-green 'Approve without Oakridge' at the top, then an outlined 'Approve and schedule all 7' of the same width. No 'recommended' label appears.

claims.claim: "Wed 30 Sep" arrival … there is no post-payment balance.
claims.evidence: run-approval-01.png, Pay date cell: 'ACH, arrives Wed 30 Sep'. The From cell shows only 'Available $212,480.19'.

claims.claim: Error (separate run): step 1 is shown as done but without counts.
claims.evidence: run-error-01.png Already done: 'Step 1: August vendor invoices collected from Bills'. run-error-02.png shows step 1 as 'bills.list succeeded' and the log as 'bills.list · succeeded', with no 52/49 counts.

claims.claim: Progress: the activity log uses step labels instead of clock times
claims.evidence: run-progress-02.png ACTIVITY LOG rows are labelled Step 1, Step 2 and Step 3, with no timestamps.

claims.claim: the flag actions that would move money read "Draft … payment" and carry a lock icon
claims.evidence: run-result-02.png: 'Draft $252.00 payment' (Calder) and 'Draft payment' (Brightline) both have a lock icon. The other actions (Review refund email, Mark as matched, Keep flagged, Mark as paid) have none.

claims.claim: a persistent "AI" mark next to "Fernhill Assistant" in every header, plus one line in the rail. The result carries a "Prepared by Fernhill Assistant (AI)" line.
claims.evidence: An [AI] badge appears before 'Fernhill Assistant' in all four -01 headers. There is a rail footnote in run-progress-02, run-approval-03 and run-error-02, and run-result-01.png's rail says 'Prepared by Fernhill Assistant (AI)…'.

claims.claim: each step has a distinct mark shape (filled check, ring with dot, pause bars, cross, dashed circle) and a state word. Flags carry a warning icon and a label.
claims.evidence: Check with 'Done' and dashed circle with 'Not started' (run-progress-02); ring with dot and 'Running' (run-progress-01); pause bars and 'Waiting for you' (run-approval-02); cross and 'Failed for 1 of 2 accounts' (run-error-02). Flag rows show ⚠ with labels such as 'Amount mismatch'.

claims.claim: Streaming is shown as a static "Now" line with a solid caret.
claims.evidence: run-progress-01.png: a dashed box reading 'NOW Checking Oakridge Office Supply INV-1057 ($2,315.40) against card transactions…' followed by a solid blue caret block.

claims.claim: Every text pair was computed at WCAG AA or better
claims.evidence: facts.md: text below AA was 0 of 132, 0 of 209, 0 of 128 and 0 of 152 measured text nodes across the four files.

notes: The first claim is only partly accurate for the result screen. There, the rail swaps permissions and activity log for Audit log and Files. Everything else matched the renders. Right-aligned amounts are visible in run-approval-01.png. The 'Approved by Dana Whitlock, 10:05:40' tag on step 4 is visible in run-result-02.png.
